offer.text: Take a Sea-Doo GTX Pro out with Nor’Banks Sailing & Watersports for a half-hour, three-quarter-hour or one-hour rental. The rental rate includes fuel, a cleaned and sanitized life vest, and instruction; additional passengers are not charged. Each Sea-Doo can carry up to three riders, subject to a maximum combined weight of 500 pounds. Prices are listed per jet ski, not per rider. The operator’s rate card links to booking with real-time availability.
